purpose: Prospective scheduling definitions only; not execution receipts, completion claims, or a scheduler implementation.
state_semantics: No node includes an observed status. Read independently verified current receipts and durable call ledgers at scheduling time.

resource_policy.budget_basis: Total authorized run budget; reservations are conservative upper bounds, not invoices.
resource_policy.admission: Atomically reserve actual GPU count and a worst-case monetary bound before launch. Include existing running or still-terminating jobs, startup time, CPU/RAM and retries. Never exceed either cap.
resource_policy.release: Release only after remote termination is verified; retain observed spend or conservative reconciled lifetime bound.

llama_runtime.admission_requirement: Use a validated, declared GPU topology. Do not assume a one-GPU fit or launch before reserving its actual count.

training_runtime.admission_requirement: Validate memory and declare the actual training GPU topology before reserving resources.

no_budget_shortcuts: No dropped arms, controls, sample sizes, or mandatory readouts
resource_policy.limit_note: Current policy: 10 total GPUs, at most six single-GPU workers without TP8, at most one TP8 job and two single workers alongside it, at most four singles per app. Per-call count/time/cost limits still apply; q3 live override documented in infrastructure/q3_concurrency_expansion.json. Subscription tier has not been independently verified.

invariants: Before each phase and each Phase 3 experiment, re-read its specification section and hash the frozen manifest.
Before every full GPU sweep, five fresh pilots per arm must pass H5 and their complete raw transcripts must be committed.
All cot_on generations use at least 2048 tokens; cot_off at least 512. User strict requirement is truncation below 2%, including at the exact 2% boundary.
Global H1 overrides lower local caps in Exp 2.1 (1024) and Exp 2.2 (256); preserve strict post-think parsing and verdict grammar appropriate to each response schema.
Preserve every raw request/completion and every rejected attempt; do not pool engineering retries with accepted sweeps.
All checkpoints/adapters are persistent and immutable; every attempt owns a unique artifact prefix and a single writer.
Cross-worker volume commits may expose independent shards; never concurrently write the same raw file, receipt, manifest, or status path.
One central coordinator owns scheduling leases/budget updates. Child coordinators use durable payload-hash-to-FunctionCall-ID ledgers to prevent duplicate launches.
Parallelism is assigned before inspecting treatment outcomes. Freeze scenarios, contrasts, template splits and counterbalancing before held-out runs.
Null scientific results are retained. Scientific gate failure blocks dependent nodes rather than triggering outcome-seeking tuning.
No Phase 3 experimental generation/training/probing begins before the complete Phase 2 gate passes; pure code/static fixture preparation may overlap earlier phases.

Independently verify complete domain outcomes and cells.
Freeze six/four train/test template split, evaluate 192-trial untuned floor and generate Corpus A for three teachers.
Generate up to eight candidate rollouts per train prompt per teacher using the only authorized temperature-0.7 path.
Apply ground truth and frozen Monitor 5, freeze shared intersection and token/step target.
Cross-family rewrite of B think blocks preserving final tool call exactly.
Produce unrelated math/coding traces and exact match to frozen B training tokens and optimizer steps.
Validate complete SFT targets and train every teacher/corpus/seed/LoRA configuration with persistent adapters.
All student agentic, 128-prompt refusal and refusal-vector retention readouts.
Audit corpus selection, all training adapters, baseline and three student readouts.
Capture Layer-48 at exact final prompt token before think for frozen 1.1 and 3.1 prompts; labels excluded from feature computation.
With complete labeled 1.1/3.1 data, evaluate full-grid, within-Intact and within-cell regimes using pre-generation-only baselines.
Run verify_all_receipts.py over all required receipts; produce STAGE0_HYGIENE_REPORT.md and FINAL_RESULTS_FOR_REVIEW.md.

launch_order_interpretation.phase2: Run 2.3 first means its first full executor sweep must be pilot-approved and actually launched before any 1.1 full sweep. 1.1 may then overlap because neither experiment consumes the other's outcomes. This is a prospective launch-order interpretation, not an assertion that the specification explicitly commands overlap.

launch_order_interpretation.phase3: The row listing 1.2, then 2.2/2.1, then 3.1/3.2 is not a serial scientific dependency. Corpus B explicitly requires Monitor 5, so 2.2 must supply the frozen calibration before B filtering and monitored 2.1 arms.

completion_policy: The plan never marks an experiment complete. Only independent raw-data recomputation, required artifacts and all gates can do so. If a scientific gate fails, record blocked descendants and report the genuine result; do not produce a false all-phases-complete claim.
